# Equations

Inline with double dollars: $$c = \pm\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$$ mid-sentence.

Single-dollar $E = mc^2$ also works.

$$
\displaystyle T_{f}(z)=\sum _{k=0}^{\infty }{\frac {(z-c)^{k}}{2\pi i}}
$$

$$asciimath
x < y
$$

Soft-wrapped inline math: $a +
b$ continues on the next line.

Prices like $5 and $6 read as math while the dialect is on.

A lone dollar sign $ stays plain text.
